title: GlossMark views
description: views.yaml: the declared projections over tier × zoom that gloss view renders. Mirrors model.Views and model.View in internal/model/files.go, which decode with KnownFields(true), so unknown keys are errors.

views.description: Projections keyed by view name. A view must have a body (null is rejected).

stringOrList.description: A single string or a list of strings (model.StringList).

curiePattern.description: A CURIE or CURIE glob selecting nodes, for example lib:* or circ:Catalog*.

doc.description: What the view shows and for whom.

include.description: CURIE patterns of nodes to include.

exclude.description: CURIE patterns of nodes to drop after inclusion.

collapse.description: Nodes matching a CURIE pattern fold into what they realize (published-as first). The only rule understood is "via realizes".

expand.description: Relation name → number of levels to expand along it (currently part-of is honoured).

show-published.description: Show implementation concepts that are published under their core name.

relations.description: Relation names to render; all when omitted.

lift.description: range-lcs replaces a boundary's edges to two or more concepts of one relation by one lifted edge to their unique least common subsumer (none when the members share several incomparable ones: the edges stay and carry noUniqueSubsumer). A curated view never lifts the concepts it names.

zoom.description: Zoom level (model.ZoomLevels), coarsest first; landscape is above every boundary.

boundaries.description: When true (the default) boundaries at or above the zoom level are shown.

slice.description: A saved slice: seed CURIEs whose feature slice (docs/adr/0023-feature-slices.md) the view shows, with context, instead of an include list. Recomputed on every build, so it tracks the code. Not allowed together with include.
